Container.Name: Factorio Server Control
Container.Overview: A maintained modern fork of the original Factorio Server Manager (OpenFactorioServerManager). Operate one Factorio dedicated server through a responsive web interface with independent profiles, portable profile backups and mod restore, saves, fixed checkpoints, compatible mods and dependencies, profile-scoped mod startup settings, stable/experimental/exact game versions, base Factorio or Space Age, world creation, resource-aware factory-map snapshots with named platform detail, logs, users and safe server controls.
Container.Description: Factorio Server Control operates one persistent Factorio headless server through an authenticated web UI. It keeps manager state, saves, mods and configuration in explicit appdata mappings; supports independent stopped profiles; lets administrators configure installed mods through engine-validated startup settings; and restores the recorded exact Factorio version across container recreation. Factory-map generation can run automatically, only while no player is online, manually, without space platforms or remain fully disabled. For original-manager migration compatibility, its technical appdata root remains factorio-server-manager and its /opt/fsm-data plus /opt/factorio paths remain stable; the public product rename does not require a storage rename. Development is generative-AI-assisted and maintainer-reviewed; the deployed manager contains no AI model and sends no runtime data to AI services.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: factorio dedicated server manager mods saves space age ofsm tricade
Container.Requires: Persistent manager-data, saves, mods and config paths are required. Internet access to Factorio's official services is required for game-version installation and requested Mod Portal operations; the manager has no built-in telemetry. Keep its HTTP Web UI on a trusted LAN/VPN or behind an HTTPS reverse proxy. Split-mount recreation needs download access to restore the recorded exact game version. The image supports linux/amd64.
Container.Changes:
### 0.21.0 (2026-10-28) - Preserve completed uploads and other actions when their follow-up refresh fails; show Retry and prevent writes against stale mod data. - Reject corrupt server settings and admin lists, serialize release changes against server startup, and return process-control and lock errors safely. - Retain account/mod-pack migration inputs and release/map recovery copies instead of deleting recoverable data after failure. - Continue after oversized log lines; preserve failed console input and reject stale checkpoint responses. - Split mixed backend modules, add full manual development/API/recovery guides, and expand static, race, browser and real-engine verification. - Refresh the reviewed official container-image digests without changing the Node/Go versions or data layout. - Existing profiles, saves, mods, game versions, HTTP contracts and storage mappings remain compatible. Go source integrations must adjust the documented helper return tuples.
### 0.20.2 (2026-10-26) - Update the Go backend to 1.26.10 for compromised-certificate rejection and the build-only Node runtime to 24.22.1 for Brotli and related security fixes. - Patch fast-uri, serialize-javascript and follow-redirects, with regression tests for URI parsing, script end tags and credential-header stripping. - Include reviewed frontend, Go module, Ubuntu image and registry-action updates; make CI dependency downloads more reliable. - No data migration, interface redesign or automatic game-version changes. Existing profiles, saves, mods, settings and storage mappings are preserved.
### 0.20.1 (2026-10-17) - Fix queued stops after failed startup and wait for pending startup during manager shutdown. - Preserve current profile and connection state when older requests or WebSocket callbacks finish late. - Disable save uploads while running, validate new password byte limits and preserve nested paths in mod downloads. - Load management pages on demand without changing navigation or discarding open work automatically; improve mobile keyboard focus and help positioning. - Remove the vulnerable braces build dependency through Tailwind 4 and update Go to 1.26.9. Use Chrome 111+, Safari 16.4+ or Firefox 128+. - Expand browser, real-engine persistence and rollback tests, and update operations/development documentation. No data migration or game-version changes.
### 0.20.0 (2026-10-07) - Add saved mod packs to a stopped profile without overwriting existing mods, enabled states, game mode or settings; preview additions and conflicts first. - Keep the original full replacement workflow as Replace mods. - Optionally preselect optional and recommended Mod Portal dependencies through a persistent manager-wide setting; the default remains off. - Include build-dependency security fixes and reviewed dependency/container-image refreshes, retaining the existing UI styling and Tailwind integration. - Updated documentation and mod-pack screenshots. No storage migration, automatic mod changes or game-version changes.
### 0.19.1 (2026-09-27) - Check profile and mod backup sizes before uploading, using the destination's configured limit. - Show the upload limit and actionable errors instead of misleading control-service connection failures for oversized backups. - Recommend individual profiles or smaller groups for large backups; FSM_MAX_UPLOAD stays configurable in MiB with the existing 512 MiB default. - Updated backup documentation and preview screenshot. No storage migration or game/profile setting changes.
### 0.19.0 (2026-09-26) - Export selected or all profiles with optional saves and checkpoints; preview imports as new inactive profiles without replacing existing data. - Restore Download all mod ZIPs with preview and confirmation, including enabled states and startup settings. - Credentials are excluded from profile backups; existing storage paths, active game version and autostart are preserved without migration. - Refreshed dependencies, backup documentation and screenshots; corrected release checks for this formatted changelog.
### 0.18.1 (2026-09-09) - Updated Sass, SVGO and js-yaml build dependencies, including upstream SVG script-filtering and YAML merge-budget security fixes. - No UI, profile, game-version, mod or storage migration changes.
### 0.18.0 (2026-09-05) - Added administrator-only, profile-scoped startup settings for installed mods, with localized controls and Factorio-engine validation. - Changes are stored atomically and preserved through profiles, mod packs and save-mod imports.
### 0.17.6 (2026-09-03) - Hardened Factorio release downloads, redirects, archive limits and local filesystem boundaries. - Refreshed the Go, npm and container security baseline and added weekly dependency maintenance.
### 0.17.5 (2026-08-27) - Save-mod import installs every available mod and reports exact releases that are no longer offered or archives that identify a different mod. - Transient or systemic failures preserve the previous mod set.
### 0.17.4 (2026-08-26) - Fixed Token mismatch during authenticated save-mod imports by using the manager's stored Mod Portal service credential in isolated sync, without exposing it in process arguments.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to open the Factorio Server Control web interface.

Config.Name: Factorio Game Port
Config.Description: UDP port used by Factorio clients to connect to the game server.

Config.Name: Manager Data (required)
Config.Description: Persistent manager database, UI users, configuration, logs, credentials, profiles, checkpoints and map snapshots. Never remove this mapping during an update.

Config.Name: Mods (required)
Config.Description: Persistent downloaded mods, built-in game-mode selection and mod-list.json.

Config.Name: Config (required)
Config.Description: Persistent Factorio server and map configuration.

Config.Name: Initial Factorio Version
Config.Description: Used only for the first installation: latest, stable or an exact version such as 2.1.14. Later UI choices are persisted across container updates.

Config.Name: Maximum Upload Size
Config.Description: Maximum size in MiB for one uploaded save, mod, mod pack or profile backup. Export fewer profiles or omit saves/checkpoints when a backup exceeds this limit.

Config.Name: Secure Session Cookie
Config.Description: Use false for Unraid's direct HTTP Web UI. Set true only when the manager is always opened through an HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: RCON Password
Config.Description: Optional internal Factorio RCON password. Leave empty to generate and persist a random password automatically.
